statement: Point the phone camera at a food or meal and get the most likely real weight of each item plus protein, carbs, fat and kcal, with honest ranges and the lowest achievable error, starting with Brazilian meals and running on-device with no paid LLM on the critical path.

goals.title: Trustworthy delivery
goals.measure: mc check passes on every commit to main, and every done task carries verify evidence (plus an accepting review when required) in the journal

goals.title: Low portion and macro error
goals.measure: On the locked weighed Brazilian benchmark, the upper 95% CI of per-meal kcal MAPE is <=30% (phase 1), <=20% (phase 2), <=15% (phase 3), with signed bias within +-10%

goals.title: Zero marginal inference cost
goals.measure: The capture-to-result pipeline runs on-device with no network call; any optional cloud fallback is confidence-gated and costs <= US$0.001 per photo

goals.title: Honest uncertainty
goals.measure: Shown 80% ranges contain the weighed truth for 75-85% of benchmark items

goals.title: Effortless capture
goals.measure: Result in <= 2 s on a 2024+ phone, with at most one confirmation tap for a typical plate

non_goals: A web app as the primary product (demo only: no LiDAR or AR poses on iPhone)
Meal plans, coaching or social features in v1
constraints: Isolated from Artisan Studio: no shared dependencies, build config or source files
The harness stays dependency-free (Node 18+ built-ins only) so any agent or CI can run it
No paid LLM API on the critical path; any fallback is optional and gated
Only commercially usable licenses for models and data (no non-commercial or AGPL components shipped)
No accuracy claim without the locked weighed benchmark
